method.reference_counts: Exact family-specific source-name reference contexts in the T18 candidate, including references on declaration lines but excluding the declaration occurrence itself by construction.
method.classification: Manual source/provenance/semantic review. No Hebrew-word detector, length heuristic, or automatic compound splitter was used.
renaming_priority: simple controlled Hebrew composition preserving the same semantic identity
